title: Unit Event — Perspective for Smile — Episode6 Blind Spot

meta.Event Outline: Wonderlands×Showtime has finished training with Shunmeiza, and is set to study stage combat with the Mikazukigumi troupe. How will Emu and the others fare on this new, intensely physical stage?!

rows.Line: Mikazukigumi Practice Area

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm baaack!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm gonna do my absolute best during today's practice too by giving it one million percent!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Where is everyone...?
Does this mean I'm the first one-derhoy...?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, I know...!
I should practice my lines for Ushiwakamaru while I wait for the others to arrive!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Notebook? Check! Phone? Check!
Alright, just gotta set it to video mode and...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Recording myself practicing makes it so easy to see how I'm doing!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Alright, everything's set!
Let's start!!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
“Oh, have you no manners?
Put away that dreadful thing and look up to the sky.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “See how beautiful the moon is tonight?”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Next, he takes a big swing at me with his naginata. But...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Ushiwakamaru isn't supposed to feel scared.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Because that super strong tengu taught him how to fight. Not only that...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (On this night, he's happy about how pretty the reflection of the moon looks on the river.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(So, he wouldn't be feeling anxious.
Relax yourself by taking a deep breath...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (You need to jump around like you're on cloud nine. You move in a way that shows his excitement...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (My hands and feet are where they need to be. My fingers are moving the way I want. And my head's tilted just right. Everything's the way I imagined...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Alright, what does the video have to say?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's take a look...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! I'm moving a lot better now compared to before!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Oh, but my fingers don't seem fully relaxed. That means I gotta try to get them even looser...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(And my eyes are fully open here...
But I still might flinch when Tsukasa swings his naginata at me. I'll need to practice that part more with him.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (What else...?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(What is this feeling...?
I'm definitely doing a much better job now.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (But the way Mr. Kijima played Ushiwakamaru made it so easy to understand what he was feeling.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(So, what's different between me and him...?
Am I just not moving the way I think Ushiwakamaru would?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Unless it's something deeper...)
Hah hah hah! You look like you have a lot on your mind!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Eep!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Mr. Kijima! When did you get here?

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Ah, about fifteen minutes ago!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: And I took the liberty of watching you play Ushiwakamaru just now!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
I thought you were good!
You've improved so much since you first joined us!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: I'm very impressed!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Really...?!
Hehe. Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, but...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Hm?
Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, it's just...
I still feel like I can do a lot better.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It feels like there's something different between your Ushiwakamaru and my portrayal of him...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Your Ushiwakamaru made it much more obvious just how much fun he was having.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, um! Do you have any advice on how I can make my portrayal of him better?

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Hmm... Well...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: You might want to think a little more about perspectives.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Perspectives...?

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Yeah. Like I told you before, Otori, I don't see anything wrong with your understanding of him.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: I can tell that you have a talent for instinctually grasping a character and playing them the way you imagine. Put another way, you have a way of seeing the little things that make them who they are.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: However, you also have a blind spot...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: A blind spot...?

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: You're good at sensing what characters and other people are feeling. But am I right in saying that you're not as great at expressing your own?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: For example...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Have you ever encountered situations where you had trouble conveying what you were thinking or feeling to someone else?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Umm... My oldest brother is all rules, rules, rules, and my other brother is like a prickly pear!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But my big sister's super soft and cuddly♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay... I sort of understand but not really...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
I apologize if I'm mistaken.
But that's what I felt based on your acting style.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Again, I don't see anything wrong with the way you've envisioned your character. That being said, as an actor, your job is to convey to the audience what he's thinking and feeling.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: To convey what he's thinking and feeling...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
How you envision Ushiwakamaru...
Just portraying him perfectly as you've imagined won't be enough.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: You need to be able to reach every member of the audience as him.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Which means you need to take a look at things from their perspective.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Conveying what I'm thinking and feeling...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Not only that...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (He looks like he's having a lot of fun...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (It was so easy to tell what Ushiwakamaru was feeling when Mr. Kijima played him that time...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Which probably means he was doing his best to communicate to the rest of us what his character was thinking and feeling...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Then, um...!
How do I learn to do that?!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
There are many ways. Not just one.
However, in my case...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: I just want as many people to see me perform as possible.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: And I performed in all sorts of different places a while back in order to accomplish that.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: All sorts of different places...?

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: All forty-seven prefectures across Japan...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What?! All of them...?!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: That's right. When I was still a university student, my friends and I traveled all over the country to put on performances.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Naturally, we couldn't perform anywhere that involved selling tickets. So, we went around to children's clubs, elderly care facilities, local festivals...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: We performed anywhere we could get an audience to watch us. We did the same play all over Japan.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: I also recorded each performance in order to see my own acting and how each audience responded to it.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: I'd use that information to prepare for my next opportunity by checking to see what I did wrong and making the necessary changes.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: I kept repeating that until I was able to see things through the eyes of many different people.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(That's amazing...!
He went that far just to become better...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (But that explains why he's such a great actor...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Which means I also have to do what I can...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Thank you for telling me that story!
I think I know what I have to do now.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I promise to learn how to better see things from other people's perspectives!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I can't really do what you did to achieve that, but I'll think of something. And my portrayal of Ushiwakamaru is gonna be absolutely amazing...!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Ah, I'll be looking forward to seeing that...
